title: Keto Beef Burger with Indian Twist
description: A spicy keto beef burger with a crunchy portuguese-inspired crust, served with a side of tangy slaw. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Form beef patties and season with salt and pepper.
Add coconut oil to the grill and cook beef patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired temperature.
Meanwhile, toast keto buns on the grill.
Assemble burgers with beef patties, lettuce, tomatoes, onions, and cheese.
Serve with a side of Indian-spiced slaw (made with shredded cabbage, mayonnaise, and Indian spices).
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
